title: Struggle is opportunity!
html:
Happy Monday!

Life is full of struggle and it is in the overcoming of it that we advance and succeed. Furniture makers know the best wood comes from old trees that have been toughened by the constant battle against nature. Like the trees our character is toughened by struggle and choosing the path of least resistance can mean we go through life without a purpose or plan.

Struggle is opportunity!

Nothing worthwhile was ever achieved without struggle and success comes to those who face difficulty head-on, overcome it and move on to meet the next challenge.

Have a wonderful week.

Glenn Edley

Quote for the week

“Although the world is full of suffering, it is also full of the overcoming of it. ”

– Helen Keller
